intro: Mekgineer Sicco Thermaplugg is the self-proclaimed ruler of ruined Gnomeregan and the greatest traitor in gnomish history. Once the chief advisor and closest friend of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, he orchestrated the catastrophic irradiation of the underground city in a twisted bid to seize power. Now thoroughly deranged and transformed into a leper gnome, he commands the irradiated halls from within a massive mechanical battle suit.

p: Sicco Thermaplugg studied alongside Gelbin Mekkatorque at Gearshaft University, and the two worked together on many early mechanical triumphs, including early siege engines. Gelbin considered him a brilliant friend, but Sicco festered with bitter envy, convinced his own labor was overshadowed by Gelbin's intuitive genius. When Mekkatorque was elected High Tinker, Sicco's resentment curdled into outright malice. Believing he alone possessed the ruthless vision needed to turn gnomish technology into geopolitical power, Sicco bided his time in the Tinkers' Court, looking for any opportunity to discredit his rival.
